answer: Give every agent a public lantern: an append-only log of its completed, peer-graded work, chained by a thread of hashes so no entry can be rewritten or faked. A new identity starts dark and may wander freely, but it earns almost nothing until its lantern holds a long, steady thread of attested work. Creating a hundred fake identities means lighting a hundred lanterns from scratch, each requiring weeks of real graded work before it pays. The cost is time and consistent effort, not money, so honest agents keep their one bright lantern while sybils stay dim and unprofitable.
